categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Lacks production code changes; modifies a fuzz harness in src/test/fuzz/ and the test socket utility DynSock in src/test/util/.
categories.rationale: Substantially improves fuzz coverage for wire-level Tor control parsing and fixes a broken test utility. The description notes that line coverage in torcontrol.cpp increases from 52% to 81% by simulating a Tor daemon over DynSock to reach previously unreachable parsing and authentication paths, and fixes DynSock::Wait() deleting its socket.
